positions.title: Veterans and Veterans Dependents Technical Assistant / IT Helpdesk
positions.description:
•	Web Admin for Cybersecurity Center and specialized web app applications.
•	Helpdesk Tier 1 Support for Veteran students on campus.
•	Responsible for training veterans in accessing cybersecurity work-study programs, scheduling, and resources.
•	In charge of documentation of procedural guidelines in computer security and forensics. 
•	Team lead for digital online training and program marketing.
•	Analyzing, troubleshooting, and implementing solutions to computer lab environments.

positions.title: WCC Cybersecurity Tutor
positions.description:
•	Provided one-on-one and group tutoring sessions to students across all CIS courses.
•	Guided students in effectively using tools such as EC-Council, TestOut, and other class-related software.
•	Supported students in troubleshooting technical challenges and applying practical solutions.

positions.title: Secretary to School Principal
positions.description:
•	Provided administrative and technical support, resolving staff computer and software issues.
•	Managed timesheets and substitute coverage, utilizing office automation systems to streamline operations.
•	Fostered strong connections with staff, students, and parents through effective communication and exceptional organizational skills.

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description: Provided administrative and technical support, resolving staff computer and software issues. Managed timesheets and substitute coverage, utilizing office automation systems to streamline operations. Managed payroll processing for teachers and aides, ensuring accurate calculation of hours, sick time, vacation time, and additional timesheets. Reviewed, corrected, and validated multiple timesheet types with differing pay structures, maintaining precision and compliance with district policies. Ensured secure handling of confidential payroll data, maintaining accuracy and protecting employee information.

positions.title: Secretary to School Principal
positions.description:
•	Supported accounts payable and warehouse teams by troubleshooting technical and office system issues.
•	Assisted with launching a company e-commerce website, providing technical support for the transition.
•	Managed correspondence and outbound shipments, ensuring confidentiality and smooth workflow.

company.name: PORT CHESTER-RYE UNION FREE SCHOOL DISTRICT

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description: Assisted in scheduling and maintaining system updates to ensure smooth operation. Coordinated school functions, including managing work orders and supply chains. Maintained communication with parents, staff, and administrators in Spanish and English. Processed and verified payroll timesheets for school staff, including aides with supplemental hours, ensuring all leave, sick, and vacation entries were coded accurately. Coordinated with district payroll and HR departments to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely and accurate compensation for employees.

positions.description:

•	Managed correspondence and outbound shipments, ensuring confidentiality and smooth workflow.

positions.title: AK3
positions.description:
•	Supported Lieutenant in charge of Procurement and Management. 
•	Accountability and Inventory of Office Supply and parts ordered for Aircraft Jets.
•	Supervised staff of three military employees, made sure Policies and Procedures were being met (OSHA, Base, other departments). 
•	Responsible for answering confidential correspondences, generated weekly and monthly reports, typed interoffice memos, handled travel arrangements, and maintained Lieutenant’s Calendar.

positions.title: Storekeeper
positions.description: Supported Lieutenant / Department Head in charge of procurement, supply, and inventory management for office supplies and aircraft jet parts in compliance with Navy and Federal Acquisition Regulation FAR policies. Maintained accountability, tracking, and reconciliation of materials using inventory control procedures and Federal Supply Classification FSC and National Stock Number NSN systems. Supervised and trained three military personnel, ensuring OSHA, base, and departmental policies and procedures were met. Handled confidential correspondence, created supply reports, prepared memos, arranged travel, and managed the Lieutenant’s calendar with Microsoft Office Suite.
